content:
The latest stable release v4.3.0 for Lean is out now!

It includes many fixes and improvements for simp, cancelling obsolete tasks when editing documents, performance improvements for Decidable instances, and of course many bug fixes and improvements to lake.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.3.0.

Std, Aesop, Mathlib, and lean4checker are all now available for v4.3.0: there is a v4.3.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

@Scott Morrison
The latest tag on the mathlib repository is still v4.3.0-rc2
